
 Usage: houston capacity [OPTIONS]

 Find how much concurrency a repro sustains before the SLO breaks.

 Doubles VUs (start, 2x, 4x, …) running the scenario at each step until a
 rule fails, then bisects between the last pass and first fail — ending with
 "handles ~N concurrent VUs" plus why it broke (event-loop lag at the wall).

╭─ Options ──╮
 --name           -n      <str>
 --scenario               <str>  which workload to scale: journey | messages | read | mixed |
                                 login | badbot
                                 [default: journey]
 --users                  <int>  spread load across up to N seeded users; 0 = admin only
                                 [default: 10]
 --slo                    <str>  the limit that defines 'capacity' [default: p95=500ms,error=2%]
 --start                  <int>  first VU step [default: 10]
 --max                    <int>  stop doubling past this many VUs [default: 640]
 --step-duration          <str>  how long each step runs [default: 20s]
 --constrain              <str>  find capacity on customer-sized hardware, e.g. "rc=2cpu/2g"
                                 (restored after)
 --report                        write a markdown report to
                                 $HOUSTON_HOME/reports
 --report-path            <str>  write the report to this file/dir instead (implies --report)
 --json                          print the result as JSON
 --help                          Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
